title: eval metrics --json emits --repo warning to stderr
prompt: Update `clawsub eval metrics` so that when `--repo <name>` is passed together with `--json` but zero events in the log match that repo, the command still prints `warning: no events for repo <name>` to stderr. Currently the warning is emitted only in the non-JSON text branch, so `clawsub eval metrics --log X --repo nonexistent --json` exits 0 with `{}` on stdout and nothing on stderr. The warning must appear on stderr regardless of `--json`. The exit code must remain 0. The JSON stdout and text behaviour for matching repos must be unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: clawsub eval metrics --log X --repo nonexistent --json prints warning to stderr
stdout in that case is still valid JSON (empty object {})
text mode (no --json) behaviour is unchanged — warning still emitted there too
unit test covers the --json warning path
